visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bustling urban street scene in Taiwan. High-contrast billboards for NAD (mentioning Bluetooth/BluOS) and KEF (mentioning Wireless Hi-Fi) are visible against a cloudy sky. Pedestrians walk through a crosswalk, including a man in a white 'MONDAY' t-shirt. The lighting is bright, natural daylight. (2) A man with a shaved head and brown scarf is interviewed in a medium shot; he touches his chin while speaking thoughtfully against a background of city greenery and buildings. (3) A man with long hair tied back wearing a black jacket and a teal bag speaks in a park-like setting with a woman in a grey blazer beside him. (4) A close-up shows a young woman with a white face mask speaking in a sunlit park with trees in the background. (5) Two young men, one in a black graphic t-shirt and the other in a denim jacket with a tan 'W' cap, are shown in a medium shot outside a modern glass building. (6) A woman in a tan coat and orange scarf speaks animatedly in a pedestrian plaza. (7) A man with glasses wearing a dark suit jacket and a grey inner shirt is interviewed at eye-level in an urban setting. (8) A woman in a black leather jacket and another with short hair converse outdoors. (9) A young woman in a white t-shirt stands in a park, gesturing with her hands while speaking. (10) A man in a grey striped sweater and white cap speaks to an interviewer holding a 'HahaTai' branded sign. (11) A man in a black polo shirt speaks emphatically with active hand gestures in a street setting with trees and buildings in the background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 哈哈台. [Subtitle]: 以兩縣市的平均薪資為基準. (2) [Variety]: 3萬5 VS 4萬3. [Subtitle]: 是3萬5的薪水留在高雄還是4萬3的薪水留在台北. (3) [Subtitle]: 在台北啊, 不然要在哪裡? [Logo]: 台北. (4) [Logo]: 高雄. [Subtitle]: 步調沒有那麼快, 人跟人相處起來不會那麼有壓力. (5) [Subtitle]: 我還是比較喜歡高雄的那個步調, 算吃的話一般平常月可能8000很快就沒了. (6) [Subtitle]: 南部有這麼高嗎? 還是我們都在平均下面? (7) [Subtitle]: 房價的落差, 我覺得是一個蠻重要的關鍵. (8) [Subtitle]: 有一些隱形成本. (9) [Logo]: 花蓮人. [Subtitle]: 都得租屋的話, 那我還是選台北, 只差8000塊的話, 搞不好升遷機會比較多. (10) [Subtitle]: 可是3.5萬在高雄就可能一直都是3.5萬欸, 在台北至少range比較廣啊. (11) [Subtitle]: 就薪水的落差的話肯定還是以現實面為主. (12) [Subtitle]: 總是有一些額外生活上的慰勞工作辛苦的一些娛樂性開支吧. (13) [Subtitle]: 台北你光房租扣掉就3萬5啦. (14) [Variety]: 那你就變邊緣人啊.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Question -> Diverse Responses -> Comparison -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a social-native street interview piece that explores the economic and lifestyle differences between northern and southern Taiwan. By comparing specific salary tiers (35k vs 43k) in Kaohsiung and Taipei, it aims to provoke discussion on living costs, career opportunities, and overall quality of life among young Taiwanese adults.
